verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at the site root and markdown versions of docs pages that point agents to a docs-level llms.txt index. The docs also explicitly tell users to hand the onboarding page to a coding agent to run setup, and many pages are served as .md. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or of how complete and current the llms.txt index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://www.greptile.com/docs/llms.txt
hand this page to your coding agent and have it run the setup for you.
